node.label: Anti-platelet antigen antibody positivity
node.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against antigens present on the surface of thrombocytes such as the glycoproteins GPIIb/IIIa, GPIb/IX, and GPIa/IIa.

contradicting.snippet: Thrombocytopenia 12 with or without myopathy: Anti-platelet antigen antibody positivity (frequency 0/2) [PCS]
